```{r set path, include=FALSE}
library(haven)

current <- getwd()
while (basename(current) != "Data_center_and_fossil_energy_Replication") {
  current <- dirname(current)
}
base_path <- current

path_raw     <- file.path(base_path, "Data", "raw")
path_temp    <- file.path(base_path, "Data", "temp")
path_use     <- file.path(base_path, "Data", "use")
path_figures <- file.path(base_path, "Results", "Figures")
path_tables  <- file.path(base_path, "Results", "Tables")

data <- read_dta(file.path(path_use, "gem_coal_plants_multi_record_sa_proximity_exposure_15_25_50km_forR_clean.dta"))
```


```{r Figure 3a regression session}
library(haven)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# Define Treatment Variables

distances <- c("15km", "25km", "50km")
types <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")

results_list <- list()
cox_models_list <- list()

# Run Cox Models

for (dist in distances) {
  
  proximity_vars <- paste0("ai_proximity_", dist, "_", types)
  proximity_formula <- paste(proximity_vars, collapse = " + ")
  
  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    proximity_formula,
    " + Capacity_MW",
    " + Start_year", 
    " + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
    " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    " + rGDP_pc",
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )
  
  tryCatch({
    
    cox_model <- coxph(
      as.formula(formula_str), 
      data = data,
      cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
      ties = "efron",
      control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
    )
    
    coef_summary <- summary(cox_model)$coefficients
    has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)
    
    # Get sample size
    n_obs <- cox_model$n
    n_events <- cox_model$nevent
    
    # extract main coefficients
    for (i in 1:4) {
      type <- types[i]
      var_name <- proximity_vars[i]
      
      if (has_robust) {
        coef_val <- coef_summary[i, "coef"]
        se <- coef_summary[i, "robust se"]
        pval <- coef_summary[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      } else {
        coef_val <- coef_summary[i, "coef"]
        se <- coef_summary[i, "se(coef)"]
        pval <- coef_summary[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      }
      
      hr <- exp(coef_val)
      ci_lower <- exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se)
      ci_upper <- exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se)
      
      result_row <- data.frame(
        Distance = dist,
        Type = type,
        Variable = var_name,
        Coefficient = coef_val,
        HR = hr,
        SE = se,
        CI_lower = ci_lower,
        CI_upper = ci_upper,
        P_value = pval,
        Sig = case_when(
          pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
          pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
          pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ ""
        ),
        N_obs = n_obs,
        N_events = n_events
      )
      
      results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- result_row
    }
    
    # save results
    model_key <- paste0(dist, "_all_types")
    cox_models_list[[model_key]] <- list(
      model = cox_model,
      distance = dist,
      formula = formula_str
    )
    
    cat(sprintf("✓ Successfully fitted model for distance: %s\n", dist))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("✗ Error in distance %s: %s\n", dist, e$message))
  })
}

# Save Results

if (length(results_list) == 0) {
  stop("No models successfully fitted!")
}

results_df <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  mutate(
    Distance_num = as.numeric(gsub("km", "", Distance))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Distance_num)

saveRDS(results_df, file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_results_joint.rds"))
saveRDS(cox_models_list, file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_models_joint.rds"))
write.csv(results_df, file.path(path_tables, "si_table1_source.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nAnalysis completed.\n")
cat(sprintf("Total distances fitted: %d\n", length(cox_models_list)))
cat(sprintf("Total coefficients: %d\n", nrow(results_df)))
cat(sprintf("Significant results (p < 0.05): %d\n", sum(results_df$P_value < 0.05)))

# print main results
print(results_df %>% dplyr::select(Distance, Type, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper, P_value, Sig, N_obs))

```


```{r Schoenfeld_test: Supplementary Table 9}

# Extract main results
cox_model <- cox_models_list[["25km_all_types"]]$model

# Schoenfeld residual test
zph_test <- cox.zph(cox_model)

# Extract results
zph_df <- as.data.frame(zph_test$table)
zph_df$Variable <- rownames(zph_df)

# Add significance status
zph_df$Status <- case_when(
  zph_df$p < 0.001 ~ "***",
  zph_df$p < 0.01 ~ "**",
  zph_df$p < 0.05 ~ "*",
  TRUE ~ ""
)

# Select and rename columns
si_table2 <- zph_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, `χ²` = chisq, `p-value` = p, Status)

# Print results
cat("--- Individual Continuous Variables ---\n")
for (i in 1:(nrow(si_table2) - 1)) {
  cat(sprintf("%s: χ² = %.2f, p = %.4f %s\n",
              si_table2$Variable[i],
              si_table2$`χ²`[i],
              si_table2$`p-value`[i],
              si_table2$Status[i]))
}

cat("\n--- Global Test ---\n")
global_row <- si_table2[si_table2$Variable == "GLOBAL", ]
cat(sprintf("GLOBAL: χ² = %.2f, p = %.4f %s\n", 
            global_row$`χ²`,
            global_row$`p-value`,
            global_row$Status))

# Save to CSV
write.csv(si_table2, 
          file = file.path(path_tables, "si_table8_source.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n✓ Table saved to:", file.path(path_tables, "si_table9_source.csv"), "\n")
cat("========================================\n")


```
```{r time dependent cox: Supplementary Table 2}
library(haven)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# Time-Dependent Cox Model

time_transform <- function(x, t, ...) {
  x * log(t + 1)
}

# 正确的公式：主效应 + 时间交互
formula_tt <- as.formula(
  "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ 
   ai_proximity_25km_before06 + tt(ai_proximity_25km_before06) +
   ai_proximity_25km_06_15 +
   ai_proximity_25km_16_19 +
   ai_proximity_25km_20_24 + tt(ai_proximity_25km_20_24) +
   Capacity_MW + tt(Capacity_MW) +
   Start_year + tt(Start_year) +
   Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ +
   Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh + tt(Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh) +
   rGDP_pc + tt(rGDP_pc) +
   strata(Alpha_3_code)"
)

cox_tt_model <- coxph(
  formula_tt,
  data = data,
  cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
  ties = "efron",
  tt = time_transform,
  control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
)

summary(cox_tt_model)

# Extract and Format Results

coef_summary <- summary(cox_tt_model)$coefficients
has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)

# Get sample size
n_obs <- cox_tt_model$n
n_events <- cox_tt_model$nevent

# define variables to be displayed
ai_vars <- c(
  "ai_proximity_25km_before06",
  "ai_proximity_25km_06_15",
  "ai_proximity_25km_16_19",
  "ai_proximity_25km_20_24",
  "tt(ai_proximity_25km_20_24)"
)

results_list <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(coef_summary)) {
  var_name <- rownames(coef_summary)[i]
  
  # extract results for variables above
  if (!var_name %in% ai_vars) next
  
  if (has_robust) {
    coef_val <- coef_summary[i, "coef"]
    se <- coef_summary[i, "robust se"]
    pval <- coef_summary[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  } else {
    coef_val <- coef_summary[i, "coef"]
    se <- coef_summary[i, "se(coef)"]
    pval <- coef_summary[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  }
  
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    Variable = var_name,
    Type = ifelse(grepl("^tt\\(", var_name), "Time Interaction", "Main Effect"),
    Coefficient = coef_val,
    HR = exp(coef_val),
    SE = se,
    CI_lower = exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se),
    CI_upper = exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se),
    P_value = pval,
    Sig = case_when(
      pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
      pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
      pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    N_obs = n_obs,
    N_events = n_events
  )
}

results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)

# save results
write.csv(results_df, 
          file.path(path_tables, "si_table2_source.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)


```


```{r Figure 3a plot session}

library(grid)
library(gtable)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Load results
if (!file.exists(file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_results_joint.rds"))) {
  stop("Results file not found! Please run Cox regression first.")
}

results_df <- readRDS(file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_results_joint.rds"))

# style

FONT_FAMILY <- "sans"
FONT_SIZE_BASE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_TITLE <- 12
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT <- 9
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_LEGEND <- 9
FONT_SIZE_CAPTION <- 8

LINE_WIDTH_AXIS <- 0.5
LINE_WIDTH_ERROR <- 0.8
POINT_SIZE <- 1.5
POINT_STROKE <- 1.2

AXIS_TEXT_MARGIN <- 4
AXIS_TITLE_MARGIN <- 8
LEGEND_KEY_SIZE <- 0.5

FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH <- unit(1.2, "cm")  
FIXED_YAXIS_WIDTH <- unit(1.5, "cm")   

nature_colors <- c(
  "before06" = "#000080",
  "06_15" = "#4169E1",
  "16_19" = "#9E1C60",
  "20_24" = "#FF4500"
)

period_labels <- c(
  "before06" = "Before 2006",
  "06_15" = "2006-2015",
  "16_19" = "2016-2019",
  "20_24" = "2020-2024"
)

period_order <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")

theme_nature_standard <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = FONT_SIZE_BASE, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY),
      plot.title = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_TITLE, hjust = 0, 
                                margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, hjust = 0, 
                                    margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_CAPTION, hjust = 0, 
                                  color = "grey20", margin = margin(t = 8), 
                                  lineheight = 1.1),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, color = "black",
                                 margin = margin(t = AXIS_TEXT_MARGIN)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, 
        color = "black",
        hjust = 1.1,              
        vjust = 1.1,              
        angle = -30,              
        margin = margin(r = 4)
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, 
                                  margin = margin(t = AXIS_TITLE_MARGIN)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, 
        angle = 90,               
        margin = margin(r = AXIS_TITLE_MARGIN)
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),
      legend.position = "none",  
      plot.margin = margin(12, 40, 12, 20),  
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

plot1_data <- results_df %>%
  filter(Distance == "25km") %>%
  mutate(
    Type_clean = case_when(
      Type == "before06" ~ "Before 2006",
      Type == "06_15" ~ "2006-2015",
      Type == "16_19" ~ "2016-2019",
      Type == "20_24" ~ "2020-2024",
      TRUE ~ Type
    ),
    Type_factor = factor(Type_clean, levels = c("Before 2006", "2006-2015", "2016-2019", "2020-2024")),
    plot_order = case_when(
      Type_clean == "Before 2006" ~ 4,
      Type_clean == "2006-2015" ~ 3,
      Type_clean == "2016-2019" ~ 2,
      Type_clean == "2020-2024" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

x_min <- min(plot1_data$CI_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(plot1_data$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
x_range <- x_max - x_min
x_limit_min <- x_min - 0.15 * x_range
x_limit_max <- x_max + 0.30 * x_range

plot1_data <- plot1_data %>%
  mutate(
    label_x = pmin(CI_upper + 0.03 * x_range, x_limit_max - 0.10 * x_range),
    hr_label = sprintf("%.3f%s", HR, Sig)
  )

forest_plot_25km <- ggplot(plot1_data, aes(x = HR, y = plot_order)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "solid", 
             color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper, color = Type), 
                 height = 0, linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_ERROR) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Type, fill = Type), 
             shape = 21, size = POINT_SIZE, stroke = POINT_STROKE) +
  geom_text(aes(x = label_x, label = hr_label, color = Type), 
            hjust = 0, size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT * 0.35, fontface = "bold",
            show.legend = FALSE, family = FONT_FAMILY) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = nature_colors, 
    labels = period_labels,
    breaks = period_order
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("before06" = "white", "06_15" = "white", 
               "16_19" = "white", "20_24" = "white"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = "Data center construction periods"
  ) +
  theme_nature_standard() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_limit_min, x_limit_max),
    breaks = pretty(c(x_min, x_max), n = 6),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:4,
    labels = c("2020-2024", "2016-2019", "2006-2015", "Before 2006"),  
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.5))
  )


plot1_grob <- ggplotGrob(forest_plot_25km)
plot1_grob$widths[2] <- FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH
plot1_grob$widths[3] <- FIXED_YAXIS_WIDTH

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(path_figures, "fig3a.pdf"),
  plot = plot1_grob,
  width = 5.5,  
  height = 4, 
  units = "in",
  device = "pdf"
)

print(forest_plot_25km)
```





```{r SI_Figure_2——buffer zone sensitivity: 15km & 50km}
# 15km & 50km Sensitivity

library(grid)
library(gtable)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Load results
if (!file.exists(file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_results_joint.rds"))) {
  stop("Results file not found! Please run Cox regression first.")
}

results_df <- readRDS(file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_results_joint.rds"))

# style

FONT_FAMILY <- "sans"
FONT_SIZE_BASE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_TITLE <- 12
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT <- 9
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_LEGEND <- 9
FONT_SIZE_CAPTION <- 8

LINE_WIDTH_AXIS <- 0.5
LINE_WIDTH_ERROR <- 0.8
POINT_SIZE <- 1.5
POINT_STROKE <- 1.2

AXIS_TEXT_MARGIN <- 4
AXIS_TITLE_MARGIN <- 8
LEGEND_KEY_SIZE <- 0.5

FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH <- unit(1.5, "cm")
FIXED_YAXIS_WIDTH <- unit(2.5, "cm")

nature_colors <- c(
  "before06" = "#000080",
  "06_15" = "#4169E1",
  "16_19" = "#9E1C60",
  "20_24" = "#FF4500"
)

period_labels <- c(
  "before06" = "Before 2006",
  "06_15" = "2006-2015",
  "16_19" = "2016-2019",
  "20_24" = "2020-2024"
)

period_order <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")

theme_nature_standard <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = FONT_SIZE_BASE, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY),
      plot.title = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_TITLE, hjust = 0, 
                                margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, hjust = 0, 
                                    margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_CAPTION, hjust = 0, 
                                  color = "grey20", margin = margin(t = 8), 
                                  lineheight = 1.1),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, color = "black",
                                 margin = margin(t = AXIS_TEXT_MARGIN)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, color = "black",
                                 margin = margin(r = AXIS_TEXT_MARGIN),
                                 hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, lineheight = 0.9),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, 
                                  margin = margin(t = AXIS_TITLE_MARGIN)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, 
                                  margin = margin(r = AXIS_TITLE_MARGIN)),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),
      legend.position = c(0.05, 0.95),
      legend.justification = c(0, 1),
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      legend.background = element_blank(),  
      legend.title = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_LEGEND, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_LEGEND),
      legend.key.size = unit(LEGEND_KEY_SIZE, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(LEGEND_KEY_SIZE, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(LEGEND_KEY_SIZE * 1.5, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 40, 12, 10),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

plot2_data <- results_df %>%
  filter(Distance %in% c("15km", "50km")) %>%
  mutate(
    Type_clean = case_when(
      Type == "before06" ~ "Before 2006",
      Type == "06_15" ~ "2006-2015",
      Type == "16_19" ~ "2016-2019",
      Type == "20_24" ~ "2020-2024",
      TRUE ~ Type
    ),
    Type_factor = factor(Type_clean, levels = c("Before 2006", "2006-2015", "2016-2019", "2020-2024")),
    Distance_label = gsub("km", " km", Distance),
    plot_order = case_when(
      Distance_label == "50 km" & Type_clean == "Before 2006" ~ 8,
      Distance_label == "50 km" & Type_clean == "2006-2015" ~ 7,
      Distance_label == "50 km" & Type_clean == "2016-2019" ~ 6,
      Distance_label == "50 km" & Type_clean == "2020-2024" ~ 5,
      Distance_label == "15 km" & Type_clean == "Before 2006" ~ 4,
      Distance_label == "15 km" & Type_clean == "2006-2015" ~ 3,
      Distance_label == "15 km" & Type_clean == "2016-2019" ~ 2,
      Distance_label == "15 km" & Type_clean == "2020-2024" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

x_min2 <- min(plot2_data$CI_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
x_max2 <- max(plot2_data$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
x_range2 <- x_max2 - x_min2
x_limit_min2 <- x_min2 - 0.15 * x_range2
x_limit_max2 <- x_max2 + 0.30 * x_range2

plot2_data <- plot2_data %>%
  mutate(
    label_x = pmin(CI_upper + 0.03 * x_range2, x_limit_max2 - 0.10 * x_range2),
    hr_label = sprintf("%.3f%s", HR, Sig)
  )

distance_breaks2 <- plot2_data %>%
  group_by(Distance_label) %>%
  summarise(y_mid = mean(plot_order)) %>%
  arrange(y_mid)

# grey backgroud
background_rects2 <- data.frame(
  ymin = 0.5,
  ymax = 4.5
)

forest_plot_sensitivity <- ggplot(plot2_data, aes(x = HR, y = plot_order)) +
  geom_rect(data = background_rects2,
            aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            fill = "grey95", alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "solid", 
             color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper, color = Type), 
                 height = 0, linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_ERROR) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Type, fill = Type), 
             shape = 21, size = POINT_SIZE, stroke = POINT_STROKE) +
  geom_text(aes(x = label_x, label = hr_label, color = Type), 
            hjust = 0, size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT * 0.35, fontface = "bold",
            show.legend = FALSE, family = FONT_FAMILY) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = nature_colors, 
    labels = period_labels,
    breaks = period_order,
    name = "Construction Period"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("before06" = "white", "06_15" = "white", 
               "16_19" = "white", "20_24" = "white"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        size = POINT_SIZE,
        stroke = POINT_STROKE,
        shape = 21,
        fill = "white",
        linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_ERROR
      )
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = "Buffer Distance"
  ) +
  theme_nature_standard() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_limit_min2, x_limit_max2),
    breaks = pretty(c(x_min2, x_max2), n = 6),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = distance_breaks2$y_mid,
    labels = distance_breaks2$Distance_label,
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.5))
  )

plot2_grob <- ggplotGrob(forest_plot_sensitivity)
plot2_grob$widths[2] <- FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH
plot2_grob$widths[3] <- FIXED_YAXIS_WIDTH

ggsave(
```

```{r SI_Table 10: dc all without distinguished periods}
library(haven)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# ========================================
# Step 1: Generate Cumulative Exposure Variable
# ========================================

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    ai_proximity_25km_cumulative = 
      ai_proximity_25km_before06 + 
      ai_proximity_25km_06_15 + 
      ai_proximity_25km_16_19 + 
      ai_proximity_25km_20_24
  )

# ========================================
# Step 2: Run Cox Model (Silent)
# ========================================

results_list_cumulative <- list()
cox_models_list_cumulative <- list()

formula_str_cumulative <- paste0(
  "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
  "ai_proximity_25km_cumulative",
  " + Capacity_MW + Start_year + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh + rGDP_pc + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
)

# Fit model silently
cox_model_cumulative <- suppressWarnings(
  coxph(
    as.formula(formula_str_cumulative), 
    data = data,
    cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
    ties = "efron",
    control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
  )
)

# Extract results
coef_summary <- summary(cox_model_cumulative)$coefficients
has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)

if (has_robust) {
  coef_val <- coef_summary[1, "coef"]
  se <- coef_summary[1, "robust se"]
  pval <- coef_summary[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
} else {
  coef_val <- coef_summary[1, "coef"]
  se <- coef_summary[1, "se(coef)"]
  pval <- coef_summary[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
}

hr <- exp(coef_val)
ci_lower <- exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se)
ci_upper <- exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se)

results_df_cumulative <- data.frame(
  Distance = "25km",
  Type = "Cumulative",
  Variable = "ai_proximity_25km_cumulative",
  Coefficient = coef_val,
  HR = hr,
  SE = se,
  CI_lower = ci_lower,
  CI_upper = ci_upper,
  P_value = pval,
  Sig = case_when(
    pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
    pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
    pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  ),
  N_obs = cox_model_cumulative$n,
  N_events = cox_model_cumulative$nevent
)

# ========================================
# Step 3: Save Results
# ========================================

saveRDS(results_df_cumulative, 
        file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_results_cumulative_25km.rds"))

saveRDS(list("25km_cumulative" = list(
  model = cox_model_cumulative,
  distance = "25km",
  formula = formula_str_cumulative
)), file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_models_cumulative_25km.rds"))

write.csv(results_df_cumulative, 
          file.path(path_tables, "si_table9_source.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("✓ Results saved to:", file.path(path_tables, "si_table10_source.csv"), "\n")
```

```{r SI_Figure 3: robustness check strata by year calculation session}
library(haven)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# Year Stratification Robustness Check

distances <- c("25km")
types <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")

results_year_strata_list <- list()
cox_models_year_strata_list <- list()


# Run Cox Models with Year Stratification

for (dist in distances) {
  
  proximity_vars <- paste0("ai_proximity_", dist, "_", types)
  proximity_formula <- paste(proximity_vars, collapse = " + ")
  
  formula_str_year <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    proximity_formula,
    " + Capacity_MW",
    " + Start_year", 
    " + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
    " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    " + rGDP_pc",
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)",
    " + strata(year)"
  )
  
  tryCatch({
    
    cox_model_year <- coxph(
      as.formula(formula_str_year), 
      data = data,
      cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
      ties = "efron",
      control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
    )
    
    coef_summary <- summary(cox_model_year)$coefficients
    has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)
    
    for (i in 1:4) {
      type <- types[i]
      var_name <- proximity_vars[i]
      
      if (has_robust) {
        coef_val <- coef_summary[i, "coef"]
        se <- coef_summary[i, "robust se"]
        pval <- coef_summary[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      } else {
        coef_val <- coef_summary[i, "coef"]
        se <- coef_summary[i, "se(coef)"]
        pval <- coef_summary[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      }
      
      hr <- exp(coef_val)
      ci_lower <- exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se)
      ci_upper <- exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se)
      
      result_row <- data.frame(
        Distance = dist,
        Type = type,
        Variable = var_name,
        Coefficient = coef_val,
        HR = hr,
        SE = se,
        CI_lower = ci_lower,
        CI_upper = ci_upper,
        P_value = pval,
        Sig = case_when(
          pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
          pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
          pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ ""
        )
      )
      
      results_year_strata_list[[length(results_year_strata_list) + 1]] <- result_row
    }
    
    model_key <- paste0(dist, "_all_types_year_strata")
    cox_models_year_strata_list[[model_key]] <- list(
      model = cox_model_year,
      distance = dist,
      formula = formula_str_year
    )
    
    cat(sprintf("✓ Successfully fitted model for distance: %s\n", dist))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("✗ Error in distance %s: %s\n", dist, e$message))
  })
}


# Process Results

if (length(results_year_strata_list) == 0) {
  stop("No models successfully fitted!")
}

results_year_strata_df <- bind_rows(results_year_strata_list) %>%
  mutate(
    Distance_num = as.numeric(gsub("km", "", Distance))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Distance_num)

saveRDS(results_year_strata_df, file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_results_year_strata.rds"))
saveRDS(cox_models_year_strata_list, file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_models_year_strata.rds"))
write.csv(results_year_strata_df, file.path(path_tables, "cox_proximity_results_year_strata.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nAnalysis completed.\n")
cat(sprintf("Total distances fitted: %d\n", length(cox_models_year_strata_list)))
cat(sprintf("Total coefficients: %d\n", nrow(results_year_strata_df)))
cat(sprintf("Significant results (p < 0.05): %d\n", sum(results_year_strata_df$P_value < 0.05)))

print(results_year_strata_df %>% dplyr::select(Distance, Type, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper, P_value, Sig))


```

```{r SI_Figure 3: robustness check strata by year plot session}
library(grid)

# Load year stratification results
if (!file.exists(file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_results_year_strata.rds"))) {
  stop("Year stratification results file not found! Please run the analysis first.")
}

results_year_strata_df <- readRDS(file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_results_year_strata.rds"))

# style

FONT_FAMILY <- "sans"
FONT_SIZE_BASE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_TITLE <- 12
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT <- 9
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_LEGEND <- 9
FONT_SIZE_CAPTION <- 8

LINE_WIDTH_AXIS <- 0.5
LINE_WIDTH_ERROR <- 0.8
POINT_SIZE <- 1.5
POINT_STROKE <- 1.2

AXIS_TEXT_MARGIN <- 4
AXIS_TITLE_MARGIN <- 8
LEGEND_KEY_SIZE <- 0.5

FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH <- unit(1.2, "cm")
FIXED_YAXIS_WIDTH <- unit(1.5, "cm")

nature_colors <- c(
  "before06" = "#000080",
  "06_15" = "#4169E1",
  "16_19" = "#9E1C60",
  "20_24" = "#FF4500"
)

period_labels <- c(
  "before06" = "Before 2006",
  "06_15" = "2006-2015",
  "16_19" = "2016-2019",
  "20_24" = "2020-2024"
)

period_order <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")

theme_nature_standard <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = FONT_SIZE_BASE, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY),
      plot.title = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_TITLE, hjust = 0, 
                                margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, hjust = 0, 
                                    margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_CAPTION, hjust = 0, 
                                  color = "grey20", margin = margin(t = 8), 
                                  lineheight = 1.1),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, color = "black",
                                 margin = margin(t = AXIS_TEXT_MARGIN)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, 
        color = "black",
        hjust = 1.1,
        vjust = 1.1,
        angle = -30,
        margin = margin(r = 4)
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, 
                                  margin = margin(t = AXIS_TITLE_MARGIN)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, 
        angle = 90,
        margin = margin(r = AXIS_TITLE_MARGIN)
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(12, 40, 12, 20),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

plot_year_strata_data <- results_year_strata_df %>%
  filter(Distance == "25km") %>%
  mutate(
    Type_clean = case_when(
      Type == "before06" ~ "Before 2006",
      Type == "06_15" ~ "2006-2015",
      Type == "16_19" ~ "2016-2019",
      Type == "20_24" ~ "2020-2024",
      TRUE ~ Type
    ),
    Type_factor = factor(Type_clean, levels = c("Before 2006", "2006-2015", "2016-2019", "2020-2024")),
    plot_order = case_when(
      Type_clean == "Before 2006" ~ 4,
      Type_clean == "2006-2015" ~ 3,
      Type_clean == "2016-2019" ~ 2,
      Type_clean == "2020-2024" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

x_min <- min(plot_year_strata_data$CI_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(plot_year_strata_data$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
x_range <- x_max - x_min
x_limit_min <- x_min - 0.15 * x_range
x_limit_max <- x_max + 0.30 * x_range

plot_year_strata_data <- plot_year_strata_data %>%
  mutate(
    label_x = pmin(CI_upper + 0.03 * x_range, x_limit_max - 0.10 * x_range),
    hr_label = sprintf("%.3f%s", HR, Sig)
  )

forest_plot_year_strata <- ggplot(plot_year_strata_data, aes(x = HR, y = plot_order)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "solid", 
             color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper, color = Type), 
                 height = 0, linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_ERROR) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Type, fill = Type), 
             shape = 21, size = POINT_SIZE, stroke = POINT_STROKE) +
  geom_text(aes(x = label_x, label = hr_label, color = Type), 
            hjust = 0, size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT * 0.35, fontface = "bold",
            show.legend = FALSE, family = FONT_FAMILY) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = nature_colors, 
    labels = period_labels,
    breaks = period_order
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("before06" = "white", "06_15" = "white", 
               "16_19" = "white", "20_24" = "white"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = "Data center construction periods",
  ) +
  theme_nature_standard() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_limit_min, x_limit_max),
    breaks = pretty(c(x_min, x_max), n = 6),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:4,
    labels = c("2020-2024", "2016-2019", "2006-2015", "Before 2006"),
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.5))
  )

# create figure frame
plot_year_strata_grob <- ggplotGrob(forest_plot_year_strata)
plot_year_strata_grob$widths[2] <- FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH
plot_year_strata_grob$widths[3] <- FIXED_YAXIS_WIDTH

  height = 4, 
  units = "in",
  device = "pdf"
)

print(forest_plot_year_strata)
```

```{r robustness：SI_Figure 4 plot session: Restrict sample to units surviving to 2020}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# =========================
# 1. Restrict sample to units surviving to 2020
#    Keep all observations for these units
# =========================

units_surviving_to_2020 <- data %>%
  group_by(GEM_unit_phase_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    retired_before_2020 = any(retire == 1 & year < 2020, na.rm = TRUE),
    observed_in_or_after_2020 = any(year >= 2020, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!retired_before_2020 & observed_in_or_after_2020) %>%
  pull(GEM_unit_phase_ID)

data_survivor2020 <- data %>%
  filter(GEM_unit_phase_ID %in% units_surviving_to_2020) %>%
  arrange(GEM_unit_phase_ID, year, time0, time1)

cat("Restricted sample summary (units surviving to 2020):\n")
cat(sprintf("Rows kept: %d\n", nrow(data_survivor2020)))
cat(sprintf("Units kept: %d\n", n_distinct(data_survivor2020$GEM_unit_phase_ID)))
cat(sprintf("Events kept: %d\n\n", sum(data_survivor2020$retire, na.rm = TRUE)))

# optional check
check_entry <- data_survivor2020 %>%
  group_by(GEM_unit_phase_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    first_year = min(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    ever_retired = any(retire == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(head(check_entry, 10))

# =========================
# 2. Define treatment variables
# =========================

distances <- c("25km")
types <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")

results_list <- list()
cox_models_list <- list()

# =========================
# 3. Cox models on restricted sample
# =========================

for (dist in distances) {
  
  proximity_vars <- paste0("ai_proximity_", dist, "_", types)
  proximity_formula <- paste(proximity_vars, collapse = " + ")
  
  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    proximity_formula,
    " + Capacity_MW",
    " + Start_year",
    " + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
    " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    " + rGDP_pc",
    " + strata(Country_Area)"
  )
  
  tryCatch({
    
    cox_model <- coxph(
      as.formula(formula_str),
      data = data_survivor2020,
      cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
      ties = "efron",
      control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
    )
    
    coef_summary <- summary(cox_model)$coefficients
    has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)
    
    n_obs <- cox_model$n
    n_events <- cox_model$nevent
    
    for (var_name in proximity_vars) {
      
      type <- sub(paste0("^ai_proximity_", dist, "_"), "", var_name)
      
      if (!(var_name %in% rownames(coef_summary))) next
      
      if (has_robust) {
        coef_val <- coef_summary[var_name, "coef"]
        se <- coef_summary[var_name, "robust se"]
        pval <- coef_summary[var_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      } else {
        coef_val <- coef_summary[var_name, "coef"]
        se <- coef_summary[var_name, "se(coef)"]
        pval <- coef_summary[var_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      }
      
      hr <- exp(coef_val)
      ci_lower <- exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se)
      ci_upper <- exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se)
      
      results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Distance = dist,
        Type = type,
        Variable = var_name,
        Coefficient = coef_val,
        HR = hr,
        SE = se,
        CI_lower = ci_lower,
        CI_upper = ci_upper,
        P_value = pval,
        Sig = case_when(
          pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
          pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
          pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ ""
        ),
        N_obs = n_obs,
        N_events = n_events
      )
    }
    
    cox_models_list[[paste0(dist, "_all_types_survivor2020")]] <- cox_model
    cat(sprintf("✓ Fitted survivor-to-2020 model: %s\n", dist))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("✗ Error for %s: %s\n", dist, e$message))
  })
}

# =========================
# 4. Output results
# =========================

if (length(results_list) == 0) {
  stop("No models successfully fitted.")
}

results_df_survivor2020 <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  mutate(Distance_num = as.numeric(gsub("km", "", Distance))) %>%
  arrange(Distance_num)

saveRDS(results_df_survivor2020, file.path(path_temp, "results_df_survivor2020.rds"))
write.csv(results_df_survivor2020, file.path(path_tables, "results_df_survivor2020.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nAnalysis completed.\n")
cat(sprintf("Total models fitted: %d\n", length(cox_models_list)))
cat(sprintf("Total coefficients: %d\n", nrow(results_df_survivor2020)))
cat(sprintf("Significant results (p < 0.05): %d\n\n",
            sum(results_df_survivor2020$P_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)))

print(
  results_df_survivor2020 %>%
    select(Distance, Type, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper, P_value, Sig, N_obs, N_events)
)
```

```{r robustness_SI_Figure4_plot_session_survivor2020}
  x_range <- 0.05
}

x_limit_min <- x_min - 0.15 * x_range
x_limit_max <- x_max + 0.30 * x_range

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    label_x = pmin(CI_upper + 0.03 * x_range, x_limit_max - 0.10 * x_range)
  )

# ============================================================
# 5. Create forest plot
# ============================================================

forest_plot_survivor2020 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = HR, y = plot_order)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "solid",
    color = "black",

  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper, color = Type),
    height = 0,

  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Type, fill = Type),
    shape = 21,
    size = POINT_SIZE,

  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x, label = hr_label, color = Type),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT * 0.35,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE,
    family = FONT_FAMILY
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = nature_colors,
    labels = period_labels,
    breaks = period_order
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "before06" = "white",
      "06_15"    = "white",
      "16_19"    = "white",
      "20_24"    = "white"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.88, 1.08),
    breaks = c(0.90, 0.95, 1.00, 1.05),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:4,
    labels = c("2020-2024", "2016-2019", "2006-2015", "Before 2006"),
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.5))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of data center exposure on coal plant retirement",
    subtitle = "Restricted sample of units surviving to 2020, 25-km threshold",
    x = "Hazard ratio (95% CI)",
    y = "Data center commissioning period",
    caption = paste(
      "***P < 0.001, **P < 0.01, *P < 0.05",
      "HR < 1 indicates delayed retirement; HR > 1 indicates accelerated retirement",
      "Cox model estimated after excluding units retired before 2020; full observation histories retained for remaining units",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  theme_nature_standard()

# ============================================================
# 6. Fix y-axis layout width for alignment

plot_grob <- ggplotGrob(forest_plot_survivor2020)
plot_grob$widths[2] <- FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH
```

```{r fig_3b: marginal survival curves calculation session}

library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# ===== Step 1: Load Model and Define Parameters =====
# Load pre-fitted Cox models from saved RDS file
# Specify the model key and target exposure variable for analysis

cox_models_list <- readRDS(file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_models_joint.rds"))

model_key <- "25km_all_types"  
var_name <- "ai_proximity_25km_20_24"  

cat(sprintf("Loading model: %s\n", model_key))
cat(sprintf("Target variable: %s\n\n", var_name))

cox_model <- cox_models_list[[model_key]]$model

if (is.null(cox_model)) {
  stop(sprintf("Model '%s' not found in cox_models_list!", model_key))
}

# ===== Step 2: Calculate Exposure Levels =====
# min_val: baseline for "no exposure" (minimum value of the variable)
# mean_exposed: average exposure level among exposed units
# These two values define the contrast for counterfactual comparison

min_val <- min(data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
exposed_vals <- data[[var_name]][data[[var_name]] > min_val]
mean_exposed <- mean(exposed_vals, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Exposure levels:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  No exposure: %.4f\n", min_val))
cat(sprintf("  Exposed: %.4f\n\n", mean_exposed))

# ===== Step 3: Extract Strata Information =====
# Group data by country (Alpha_3_code)
# Calculate sample size (n) and weight for each stratum
# Weights are used for marginalization (weighted averaging) later

strata_info <- data %>%
  group_by(Alpha_3_code) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(weight = n / sum(n))

cat(sprintf("Total strata: %d\n\n", nrow(strata_info)))

required_vars <- c(
  "ai_proximity_25km_before06",
  "ai_proximity_25km_06_15",
  "ai_proximity_25km_16_19",
  "ai_proximity_25km_20_24",  
  "Capacity_MW",
  "Start_year",
  "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  "rGDP_pc",
  "Alpha_3_code"
)

# ===== Step 4: Calculate Survival Curves for Each Stratum =====
# For each country (stratum):
#   4.1 Get a template row with complete data
#   4.2 Create two scenarios: no AI exposure vs. AI exposure
#       - Set all other covariates to their global means (held constant)
#       - Only vary the target variable (ai_proximity_25km_20_24)
#   4.3 Predict survival curves using survfit() for both scenarios
#   4.4 Store results

strata_curves <- list()
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(strata_info), style = 3)

for (i in 1:nrow(strata_info)) {
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  strata_row <- strata_info[i, ]
  
  tryCatch({
    # Get a template row
    template_row <- data %>%
      filter(
        Alpha_3_code == strata_row$Alpha_3_code,
        complete.cases(data[, required_vars])
      ) %>%
      slice(1)
    
    if (nrow(template_row) == 0) next
    
    # Create two scenarios: no AI exposure vs. AI exposure
    newdata_no_ai <- template_row[, required_vars]
    newdata_ai <- template_row[, required_vars]
    
    # Set all other covariates to their global means
    continuous_vars <- c(
      "ai_proximity_25km_before06",  
      "ai_proximity_25km_06_15",
      "ai_proximity_25km_16_19",
      # "ai_proximity_25km_20_24",  # Only vary the target variable
      "Capacity_MW",
      "Start_year",
      "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
      "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
      "rGDP_pc"
    )
    
    for (var in continuous_vars) {
      newdata_no_ai[[var]] <- mean(data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      newdata_ai[[var]] <- mean(data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    
    # Only vary the target variable
    newdata_no_ai[["ai_proximity_25km_20_24"]] <- min_val
    newdata_ai[["ai_proximity_25km_20_24"]] <- mean_exposed
    
    # Predict survival curves
    surv_no_ai <- suppressWarnings(survfit(cox_model, newdata = newdata_no_ai))
    surv_ai <- suppressWarnings(survfit(cox_model, newdata = newdata_ai))
    
    if (length(surv_no_ai$time) == 0 || length(surv_ai$time) == 0) next
    
    strata_curves[[length(strata_curves) + 1]] <- list(
      no_ai = data.frame(
        time = surv_no_ai$time, 
        surv = surv_no_ai$surv, 
        weight = strata_row$weight
      ),
      ai = data.frame(
        time = surv_ai$time, 
        surv = surv_ai$surv, 
        weight = strata_row$weight
      ),
      strata_id = i, 
      country = strata_row$Alpha_3_code,
      n = strata_row$n
    )
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("\nError in strata %d (%s): %s\n", 
                i, strata_row$Alpha_3_code, e$message))
  })
}

close(pb)
cat(sprintf("\n✓ Successfully processed: %d/%d strata\n\n", 
            length(strata_curves), nrow(strata_info)))

if (length(strata_curves) == 0) {
  stop("No strata successfully processed!")
}

# Store results with stratum weight

all_times_no_ai <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(strata_curves, function(x) x$no_ai$time))))
all_times_ai <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(strata_curves, function(x) x$ai$time))))

calc_weighted_surv <- function(time_points, curves_list, scenario) {
  sapply(time_points, function(t) {
    surv_at_t <- sapply(curves_list, function(curve) {
      curve_data <- curve[[scenario]]
      idx <- which(curve_data$time <= t)
      if (length(idx) > 0) curve_data$surv[max(idx)] else 1
    })
    weights <- sapply(curves_list, function(x) x[[scenario]]$weight[1])
    sum(surv_at_t * weights) / sum(weights)
  })
}

surv_no_ai_marginal <- calc_weighted_surv(all_times_no_ai, strata_curves, "no_ai")
surv_ai_marginal <- calc_weighted_surv(all_times_ai, strata_curves, "ai")

# format
survival_df <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(
    time = 0, 
    Survival = 1, 
    AI_Status = c("No AI Exposure", "AI Exposure")
  ),
  data.frame(
    time = all_times_no_ai, 
    Survival = surv_no_ai_marginal, 
    AI_Status = "No AI Exposure"
  ),
  data.frame(
    time = all_times_ai, 
    Survival = surv_ai_marginal, 
    AI_Status = "AI Exposure"
  )
) %>%
  arrange(AI_Status, time) %>%
  mutate(
    AI_Status = factor(
      AI_Status, 
      levels = c("No AI Exposure", "AI Exposure")
    )
  )

# Save Data
saveRDS(survival_df, file.path(path_temp, "survival_curve_25km_20_24_data.rds"))
write.csv(survival_df, file.path(path_tables, "survival_curve_25km_20_24_data.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

metadata <- list(
  model_key = model_key,
  var_name = var_name,
  min_val = min_val,
  mean_exposed = mean_exposed,
  n_strata = length(strata_curves),
  n_exposed = length(exposed_vals)
)
saveRDS(metadata, file.path(path_temp, "survival_curve_25km_20_24_metadata.rds"))
```

```{r fig_4a-b_hetero_calculate_section}

library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Configuration
FOCAL_DISTANCE <- "25km"
FOCAL_TYPE <- "20_24"
FOCAL_VAR <- paste0("ai_proximity_", FOCAL_DISTANCE, "_", FOCAL_TYPE)

# Step 1: Prepare Data with Standardized Variables
prepare_interaction_data <- function(data) {
  
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh = as.numeric(as.vector(Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh)),
      co2_intensity = as.numeric(as.vector(co2_intensity))
    )
  
  stats <- data %>%
    summarise(
      AI_mean = mean(.data[[FOCAL_VAR]], na.rm = TRUE),
      AI_sd = sd(.data[[FOCAL_VAR]], na.rm = TRUE),
      HR_mean = mean(Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh, na.rm = TRUE),
      HR_sd = sd(Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh, na.rm = TRUE),
      CO2_mean = mean(co2_intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
      CO2_sd = sd(co2_intensity, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  assign("heterogeneity_stats", stats, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  focal_var_std <- paste0(FOCAL_VAR, "_std")
  
  data_prepared <- data %>%
    mutate(
      !!focal_var_std := (.data[[FOCAL_VAR]] - stats$AI_mean) / stats$AI_sd,
      Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh_std = (Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh - stats$HR_mean) / stats$HR_sd,
      co2_intensity_std = (co2_intensity - stats$CO2_mean) / stats$CO2_sd,
      AI_x_Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh_std = .data[[focal_var_std]] * Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh_std,
      AI_x_co2_intensity_std = .data[[focal_var_std]] * co2_intensity_std
    )
  
  return(data_prepared)
}

# Step 2: Define Interaction Models
run_interaction_model <- function(data, interaction_var, interaction_name) {
  
  interaction_term <- paste0("AI_x_", interaction_var)
  focal_var_std <- paste0(FOCAL_VAR, "_std")
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[interaction_var]]) & is.finite(.data[[interaction_var]]))
  
  cat(sprintf("Sample: N=%d observations\n", nrow(df)))
  
  other_proximity_vars <- paste0("ai_proximity_", FOCAL_DISTANCE, "_", 
                                 c("before06", "06_15", "16_19"))
  
  main_effects <- c(
    other_proximity_vars,
    focal_var_std,
    interaction_var,
    "Capacity_MW",
    "Start_year",
    "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
    "rGDP_pc"
  )
  
  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    paste(main_effects, collapse = " + "),
    " + ", interaction_term,
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )
  
  cat("\nModel Formula:\n")
  cat(formula_str, "\n\n")
  
  tryCatch({
    
    cox_model <- coxph(
      as.formula(formula_str),
      data = df,
      cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
      ties = "efron",
      control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
    )
    
    coef_summary <- summary(cox_model)$coefficients
    
    main_row <- which(rownames(coef_summary) == focal_var_std)
    int_row <- which(rownames(coef_summary) == interaction_term)
    mod_row <- which(rownames(coef_summary) == interaction_var)
    
    se_col <- ifelse("robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary), "robust se", "se(coef)")
    
    main_coef <- coef_summary[main_row, "coef"]
    main_se <- coef_summary[main_row, se_col]
    main_pval <- coef_summary[main_row, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    int_coef <- coef_summary[int_row, "coef"]
    int_se <- coef_summary[int_row, se_col]
    int_pval <- coef_summary[int_row, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    mod_coef <- if(length(mod_row) > 0) coef_summary[mod_row, "coef"] else NA
    mod_se <- if(length(mod_row) > 0) coef_summary[mod_row, se_col] else NA
    mod_pval <- if(length(mod_row) > 0) coef_summary[mod_row, "Pr(>|z|)"] else NA
    
    get_sig <- function(p) {
      case_when(
        p < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p < 0.01 ~ "**",
        p < 0.05 ~ "*",
        p < 0.1 ~ "+",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    }
    
    main_sig <- get_sig(main_pval)
    int_sig <- get_sig(int_pval)
    
    me_at_mean <- main_coef
    me_at_plus1sd <- main_coef + int_coef
    me_at_minus1sd <- main_coef - int_coef
    
    cat("\n----------------------------------------\n")
    cat("Results:\n")
    cat("----------------------------------------\n")
    cat(sprintf("Main Effect (AI, standardized):     β=%.4f (SE=%.4f), HR=%.3f, p=%.4f %s\n",
                main_coef, main_se, exp(main_coef), main_pval, main_sig))
    cat(sprintf("Moderator Effect (%s, std):         β=%.4f (SE=%.4f), HR=%.3f, p=%.4f\n",
                interaction_name, mod_coef, mod_se, exp(mod_coef), mod_pval))
    cat(sprintf("Interaction (AI × %s):              β=%.4f (SE=%.4f), p=%.4f %s\n",
                interaction_name, int_coef, int_se, int_pval, int_sig))
    cat("\nMarginal Effects of AI (per 1 SD increase):\n")
    cat(sprintf("  When Moderator at Mean (Z=0):      β=%.4f, HR=%.3f\n", 
                me_at_mean, exp(me_at_mean)))
    cat(sprintf("  When Moderator at Mean+1SD (Z=+1): β=%.4f, HR=%.3f\n", 
                me_at_plus1sd, exp(me_at_plus1sd)))
    cat(sprintf("  When Moderator at Mean-1SD (Z=-1): β=%.4f, HR=%.3f\n", 
                me_at_minus1sd, exp(me_at_minus1sd)))
    cat("----------------------------------------\n")
    
    n_obs <- cox_model$n
    n_retirements <- cox_model$nevent
    model_rows <- as.numeric(names(cox_model$residuals))
    df_actual <- df[model_rows, ]
    n_units <- n_distinct(df_actual$GEM_unit_phase_ID)
    n_countries <- n_distinct(df_actual$Alpha_3_code)
    
    return(data.frame(
      Moderator = interaction_name,
      N_Observations = n_obs,
      N_units = n_units,
      N_Countries = n_countries,
      N_Retirements = n_retirements,
      Main_Coef = main_coef,
      Main_SE = main_se,
      Main_HR = exp(main_coef),
      Main_P = main_pval,
      Main_Sig = main_sig,
      Moderator_Coef = mod_coef,
      Moderator_SE = mod_se,
      Moderator_HR = exp(mod_coef),
      Moderator_P = mod_pval,
      Interaction_Coef = int_coef,
      Interaction_SE = int_se,
      Interaction_P = int_pval,
      Interaction_Sig = int_sig,
      ME_at_Mean = me_at_mean,
      ME_at_Mean_HR = exp(me_at_mean),
      ME_at_Plus1SD = me_at_plus1sd,
      ME_at_Plus1SD_HR = exp(me_at_plus1sd),
      ME_at_Minus1SD = me_at_minus1sd,
      ME_at_Minus1SD_HR = exp(me_at_minus1sd),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("✗ Error: %s\n", e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Step 3: Run
data_prepared <- prepare_interaction_data(data)

moderators <- list(
  list(var = "co2_intensity_std", name = "CO2 Intensity"),
  list(var = "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh_std", name = "Heat Rate")
)

all_results <- lapply(moderators, function(mod) {
  run_interaction_model(data_prepared, mod$var, mod$name)
})

results_interaction <- bind_rows(all_results[!sapply(all_results, is.null)])

# Step 4: Format and Save Results
results_formatted <- results_interaction %>%
  mutate(
    Moderator = factor(Moderator, levels = c("CO2 Intensity", "Heat Rate"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Moderator) %>%
  mutate(
    `DCE2020-2024 Coef. [95% CI]` = sprintf(
      "%.4f%s [%.4f, %.4f]",
      Main_Coef, Main_Sig,
      Main_Coef - 1.96 * Main_SE,
      Main_Coef + 1.96 * Main_SE
    ),
    `HR [95% CI]` = sprintf(
      "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
      Main_HR,
      exp(Main_Coef - 1.96 * Main_SE),
      exp(Main_Coef + 1.96 * Main_SE)
    ),
    `Interact term [95% CI]` = sprintf(
      "%.4f%s [%.4f, %.4f]",
      Interaction_Coef, Interaction_Sig,
      Interaction_Coef - 1.96 * Interaction_SE,
      Interaction_Coef + 1.96 * Interaction_SE
    ),
    `Interact p-value` = sprintf("%.4f", Interaction_P)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Moderator,
    `DCE2020-2024 Coef. [95% CI]`,
    `HR [95% CI]`,
    `Interact term [95% CI]`,
    `Interact p-value`,
    N_Observations,
    N_units,
    N_Retirements
  ) %>%
  rename(
    `Moderating Variable` = Moderator,
    `N (Obs.)` = N_Observations,
    `N (Units)` = N_units,
    `N (Retired)` = N_Retirements
  )

print(results_formatted, row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(results_interaction, file.path(path_temp, "heterogeneity_interaction_results.rds"))
write.csv(
  results_formatted,
  file.path(path_tables, "si_table5_source.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r fig_4a-b: plot section}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

COLOR_HIGH <- "#B8001F"    # Mean+1SD
COLOR_MEAN <- "#FF4500"    # Mean
COLOR_LOW <- "#48CFCB"     # Mean-1SD

theme_nature <- theme_minimal(base_size = 10, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(

    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 4)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 4)),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
    
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
    
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )


create_moderation_plot <- function(moderator_name, 
                                  main_coef, 
                                  interaction_coef,
                                  main_se,
                                  interaction_se,
                                  moderator_label = NULL,
                                  use_expression = FALSE, 
                                  show_legend = TRUE) {
  
  if (is.null(moderator_label)) moderator_label <- moderator_name
  
  # caculate marginal effects
  z_values <- seq(-2, 2, by = 0.1)
  
  marginal_effects <- data.frame(
    z = z_values,
    beta = main_coef + interaction_coef * z_values
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      se = sqrt(main_se^2 + (z * interaction_se)^2),
      hr = exp(beta),
      hr_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * se),
      hr_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * se)
    )
  
  key_points <- data.frame(
    z = c(-1, 0, 1),
    label = factor(c("Mean-1SD (Low)", "Mean", "Mean+1SD (High)"),
                  levels = c("Mean-1SD (Low)", "Mean", "Mean+1SD (High)"))
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      beta = main_coef + interaction_coef * z,
      se = sqrt(main_se^2 + (z * interaction_se)^2),
      hr = exp(beta),
      hr_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * se),
      hr_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * se)
    )
  
  # sig
  interaction_p <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(interaction_coef / interaction_se)))
  
  subtitle_text <- sprintf(
    "Interaction: Coef = %.3f, SE = %.3f, p %s",
    interaction_coef,
    interaction_se,
    ifelse(interaction_p < 0.001, "< 0.001",
           ifelse(interaction_p < 0.01, "< 0.01",
                  ifelse(interaction_p < 0.05, "< 0.05",
                         sprintf("= %.3f", interaction_p))))
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(marginal_effects, aes(x = z, y = hr)) +
    
    # reference line (HR = 1)
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
    
    # ci
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = hr_lower, ymax = hr_upper), 
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey50") +
    
    # line
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    
    # points
    geom_point(data = key_points, 
               aes(x = z, y = hr, color = label),
               size = 3, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 1.2) +
    
    # error bar
    geom_errorbar(data = key_points,
                  aes(x = z, ymin = hr_lower, ymax = hr_upper, color = label),
                  width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.6) +
    
    # color
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Mean-1SD (Low)" = COLOR_LOW,
      "Mean" = COLOR_MEAN,
      "Mean+1SD (High)" = COLOR_HIGH
    )) +
    
    # X-axis
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
      labels = c("-2SD", "-1SD", "Mean", "+1SD", "+2SD")
    ) +
    
    # Y-axis
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0.2, 1.6, by = 0.2),
      labels = sprintf("%.1f", seq(0.2, 1.6, by = 0.2)),
      limits = c(0.2, 1.6)
    ) +
    
    theme_nature +
    theme(
      legend.position = c(0.05, 0.05),
      legend.justification = c(0, 0),
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "lines"),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
  
  if (use_expression) {
    p <- p + labs(
      title = moderator_name,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = moderator_label,  
      y = "Hazard Ratio"
    )
  } else {
    p <- p + labs(
      title = moderator_name,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = paste0(moderator_label, " (Standardized)"),
      y = "Hazard Ratio"
    )
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Generate Plots
```

```{r fig_4c: hetero_calculation_section}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Configuration
FOCAL_DISTANCE <- "25km"
FOCAL_TYPE <- "20_24"
FOCAL_VAR <- paste0("ai_proximity_", FOCAL_DISTANCE, "_", FOCAL_TYPE)

prepare_emission_group_data <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ = as.numeric(as.vector(Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ)),
      EF_Group = case_when(
        Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ == 94600 ~ "Bituminous",
        Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ == 96100 ~ "Sub-bituminous",
        Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ == 98300 ~ "Anthracite",
        Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ == 101000 ~ "Lignite",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      EF_Group = factor(
        EF_Group,
        levels = c("Bituminous", "Sub-bituminous", "Anthracite", "Lignite")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(EF_Group)) %>%
    mutate(EF_Group = relevel(EF_Group, ref = "Lignite"))
}

run_emission_group_interaction_model <- function(data) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(EF_Group))
  
  other_proximity_vars <- paste0("ai_proximity_", FOCAL_DISTANCE, "_",
                                 c("before06", "06_15", "16_19"))
  
  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    paste(other_proximity_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " + ", FOCAL_VAR,
    " * EF_Group",
    " + Capacity_MW",
    " + Start_year",
    " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    " + rGDP_pc",
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )
  
  cat("\nModel Formula:\n")
  cat(formula_str, "\n\n")
  
  cox_model <- coxph(
    as.formula(formula_str),
    data = df,
    cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
    ties = "efron",
    control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
  )
  
  used_rows <- as.numeric(rownames(model.frame(cox_model)))
  df_actual <- df[used_rows, , drop = FALSE]
  
  n_obs <- nrow(df_actual)
  n_retirements <- sum(df_actual$retire, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_units <- n_distinct(df_actual$GEM_unit_phase_ID)
  
  b <- coef(cox_model)
  V <- vcov(cox_model)
  coef_names <- names(b)
  
  base_name <- FOCAL_VAR
  if (!(base_name %in% coef_names)) {
    stop(sprintf("Base coefficient %s not found.", base_name))
  }
  
  ref_group <- "Lignite"
  groups <- levels(df$EF_Group)
  results_list <- list()
  
  for (g in groups) {
    
    if (g == ref_group) {
      diff_coef <- 0
      diff_se <- NA
      diff_p <- NA
      ci_lower <- NA
      ci_upper <- NA
    } else {
      int_name1 <- paste0(FOCAL_VAR, ":EF_Group", g)
      int_name2 <- paste0("EF_Group", g, ":", FOCAL_VAR)
      int_name <- if (int_name1 %in% coef_names) int_name1 else int_name2
      
      if (!(int_name %in% coef_names)) {
        stop(sprintf("Interaction term for group %s not found.", g))
      }
      
      L_diff <- rep(0, length(b))
      names(L_diff) <- coef_names
      L_diff[int_name] <- 1
      
      diff_coef <- sum(L_diff * b)
      diff_se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(L_diff) %*% V %*% L_diff))
      diff_z <- diff_coef / diff_se
      diff_p <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(diff_z)))
      ci_lower <- diff_coef - 1.96 * diff_se
      ci_upper <- diff_coef + 1.96 * diff_se
    }
    
    results_list[[g]] <- data.frame(
      EF_Group = g,
      N_Observations = n_obs,
      N_Units = n_units,
      N_Retirements = n_retirements,
      Interaction_Coef = diff_coef,
      Interaction_SE = diff_se,
      Interaction_CI_Lower = ci_lower,
      Interaction_CI_Upper = ci_upper,
      Interaction_P = diff_p,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
  
  return(list(
    model = cox_model,
    vcov = V,
    results = results_df
  ))
}

# Run
data_emission_group <- prepare_emission_group_data(data)
emission_group_output <- run_emission_group_interaction_model(data_emission_group)

results_emission_group <- emission_group_output$results

results_emission_group_table <- results_emission_group %>%
  mutate(
    `Interaction coef. [95% CI]` = case_when(
      EF_Group == "Lignite" ~ "Reference",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.4f [%.4f, %.4f]",
                     Interaction_Coef,
                     Interaction_CI_Lower,
                     Interaction_CI_Upper)
    ),
    `p-value` = case_when(
      EF_Group == "Lignite" ~ "",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.4f", Interaction_P)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `Emission Factor Group` = EF_Group,
    `Interaction coef. [95% CI]`,
    `p-value`,
    `N (Observations)` = N_Observations,
    `N (Units)` = N_Units,
    `N (Retirements)` = N_Retirements
  )

write.csv(
  results_emission_group_table,
  file = file.path(path_tables, "si_table6_source.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(results_emission_group_table, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r figure 5a: aft model plot session}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(grid)
library(gtable)
library(haven)

# Hard-coded Results from Stata 

results_25km <- data.frame(
  Type = c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24"),
  Coefficient = c(-0.0009005, -0.0010958, -0.0007482, 0.020806),
  SE = c(0.0017908, 0.0014951, 0.0012386, 0.0052207),
  P_value = c(0.615, 0.464, 0.546, 0.000),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Calculate Acceleration Factor (exp(coef))

results_25km <- results_25km %>%
  mutate(
    AF = exp(Coefficient),  # Acceleration Factor
    AF_lower = exp(Coefficient - 1.96 * SE),
    AF_upper = exp(Coefficient + 1.96 * SE),
    Sig = case_when(
      P_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      P_value < 0.1 ~ "+",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    Type_clean = case_when(
      Type == "before06" ~ "Before 2006",
      Type == "06_15" ~ "2006-2015",
      Type == "16_19" ~ "2016-2019",
```

```{r supplementary fig 4: plot_placebo: random permutation: calculation session}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(parallel)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)

dist <- "25km"
proximity_vars <- paste0("ai_proximity_", dist, "_", c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24"))

formula_str <- paste0(
  "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
  paste(proximity_vars, collapse = " + "),
  " + Capacity_MW + Start_year + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh + rGDP_pc + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
)

target_var   <- "ai_proximity_25km_20_24"
id_var       <- "GEM_unit_phase_ID"

# real model

cox_true <- coxph(
  as.formula(formula_str),
  data = data,
  cluster = data[[id_var]],
  ties = "efron"
)

true_coef <- unname(coef(cox_true)[target_var])
true_se <- summary(cox_true)$coefficients[target_var, "se(coef)"]
true_pval <- summary(cox_true)$coefficients[target_var, "Pr(>|z|)"]
true_hr <- exp(true_coef)


# random permute

placebo_iteration_full_sample <- function(i, data, target_var, 
                                          id_var, formula_str) {
  set.seed(100000 + i)
  
  df <- data
  
  idx_non_na <- !is.na(df[[target_var]])
  
  if (sum(idx_non_na) > 0) {
    values_to_shuffle <- df[[target_var]][idx_non_na]
    shuffled_values <- sample(values_to_shuffle, length(values_to_shuffle), replace = FALSE)
    df[[target_var]][idx_non_na] <- shuffled_values
  }
  
  # run cox
  tryCatch({
    cox_placebo <- coxph(
      as.formula(formula_str),
      data = df,
      cluster = df[[id_var]],
      ties = "efron"
    )
    
    coef_val <- unname(coef(cox_placebo)[target_var])
    se_val <- summary(cox_placebo)$coefficients[target_var, "se(coef)"]
    pval_val <- summary(cox_placebo)$coefficients[target_var, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    return(c(iter = i, coef = coef_val, se = se_val, pval = pval_val))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(c(iter = i, coef = NA, se = NA, pval = NA))
  })
}

# 500 times

n_iter <- 500
n_cores <- min(detectCores() - 1, 8)

cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)

clusterExport(cl, c("data", "target_var", "id_var", "formula_str",
                    "placebo_iteration_full_sample"),
              envir = environment())

invisible(clusterEvalQ(cl, {
  library(survival)
  library(dplyr)
}))

start_time <- Sys.time()
placebo_list <- parLapply(
  cl, 1:n_iter,
  function(i) placebo_iteration_full_sample(
    i = i, data = data, target_var = target_var, 
    id_var = id_var, formula_str = formula_str
  )
)
end_time <- Sys.time()

stopCluster(cl)
rm(cl)
gc()

time_elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs"))

# results

placebo_df <- do.call(rbind, placebo_list) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(!is.na(coef))

colnames(placebo_df) <- c("iter", "coef", "se", "pval")

placebo_mean <- mean(placebo_df$coef)
placebo_sd <- sd(placebo_df$coef)

# sig check
placebo_p_1sided <- mean(placebo_df$coef <= true_coef)

z_score <- (true_coef - placebo_mean) / placebo_sd
pval_less_005 <- mean(placebo_df$pval < 0.05)

saveRDS(placebo_df, file.path(path_temp, "placebo_results_full_sample_500.rds"))
write.csv(placebo_df, file.path(path_tables, "placebo_results_full_sample_500.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r supplementary fig 5: plot_placebo: random permutation: plot session}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Calculate key statistics
placebo_mean <- mean(placebo_df$coef)
placebo_sd <- sd(placebo_df$coef)
placebo_p_1sided <- mean(placebo_df$coef <= true_coef)
z_score <- (true_coef - placebo_mean) / placebo_sd

# 1. Calculate kernel density estimation
density_placebo <- density(placebo_df$coef, adjust = 1.1, na.rm = TRUE)
density_df <- data.frame(
  x = density_placebo$x,
  y = density_placebo$y
)

# 2. Trim density curve tails
y_threshold <- max(density_df$y) * 0.01
density_df <- density_df %>%
  filter(y >= y_threshold)

# 3. Color scheme
color_density <- "#7A0019"
color_null <- "grey35"

# 4. Optimize x-axis range
xlim_range <- range(density_df$x, true_coef, finite = TRUE)
x_padding <- diff(xlim_range) * 0.05
xlim_range <- c(xlim_range[1] - x_padding, xlim_range[2] + x_padding)

# 5. Calculate annotation positions
y_at_true <- approx(density_df$x, density_df$y, xout = true_coef, rule = 2)$y
y_top <- max(density_df$y, na.rm = TRUE)

# True effect label: put on the RIGHT side of dashed line
y_true_label <- max(1.5, y_at_true * 0.15)
x_true_label <- true_coef + 0.002

# Placebo stats text: move MUCH more to the right
x_stats_label <- xlim_range[1] + 0.24 * diff(xlim_range)
y_stats_label <- y_top * 0.95

# 6. Create plot
p <- ggplot() +

  # Density curve
  geom_line(
    data = density_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    color = color_density,
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +

  # Null line (vertical)
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = color_null,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # True coefficient line (vertical dashed)
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = true_coef,
    color = color_null,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # Annotation: True effect (RIGHT of dashed line)
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = x_true_label,
    y = y_true_label,
    label = "True effect",
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0,
    size = 3.4,
    color = color_null
  ) +

  # Annotation: Statistical info (moved right a lot)
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = x_stats_label,
    y = y_stats_label,
    label = sprintf(
      "Placebo mean = %.3f\nZ-score = %.2f\np(one-sided) = %.3f\nn = %d",
      placebo_mean, z_score, placebo_p_1sided, nrow(placebo_df)
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 3.2,
    color = "black",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +

  # Axis settings
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = xlim_range,
    ylim = c(0, y_top * 1.05),
    expand = FALSE,
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Estimator",
    y = "Density",
    title = "Placebo Test: Randomization",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "True: beta = %.4f, HR = %.3f, p = %.4f | Placebo p(one-sided) = %.3f",
      true_coef, true_hr, true_pval, placebo_p_1sided
    )
  ) +

  # Theme settings
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(b = 8)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(2.5, "mm"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(6, 18, 6, 6)
  )

# 7. Save figure
dir.create(path_figures, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(path_figures, "si_fig5.pdf"),
  plot = p,
  width = 180,
  height = 120,
  units = "mm",
  device = "pdf"
)

print(p)
```

```{r supplementary fig 6：PSM}
sapply(c("MatchIt", "cobalt"), function(pkg) {

library(MatchIt)
library(cobalt)

# ============================================================
# 0. Mark special emission-factor records and replace with NA
# ============================================================

special_ef_values <- c(9460, 9610, 10100)

special_ef_n <- data %>%
  filter(Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ %in% special_ef_values) %>%
  nrow()

cat(sprintf(
  "\nSpecial emission-factor records replaced with NA: %d\n",
  special_ef_n
))

# ============================================================
# 1. Prepare baseline data
# ============================================================

baseline_data <- data %>%
  group_by(GEM_unit_phase_ID) %>%
  arrange(time0) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    treated = as.integer(
      GEM_unit_phase_ID %in%
        (data %>%
           filter(ai_treat_25km_20_24 == 1) %>%
           pull(GEM_unit_phase_ID) %>%
           unique())
    ),
    Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ = ifelse(
      Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ %in% special_ef_values,
      NA,
      Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Capacity_MW),
    !is.na(Start_year),
    !is.na(Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh),
    !is.na(Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ),
    !is.na(rGDP_pc)
  )

cat(sprintf("Baseline sample after cleaning: %d units\n", nrow(baseline_data)))
cat(sprintf("Treated units in baseline sample: %d\n", sum(baseline_data$treated == 1)))
cat(sprintf("Control units in baseline sample: %d\n", sum(baseline_data$treated == 0)))

# ============================================================
# 2. Matching
# ============================================================

psm_formula <- treated ~ Capacity_MW + Start_year +
  Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh +
  Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ

set.seed(123)
match_out <- matchit(
  psm_formula,
  data = baseline_data,
  method = "nearest",
  distance = "glm",
  link = "logit",
  ratio = 10,
  replace = FALSE,
  caliper = 0.2
)

print(summary(match_out))

    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    proximity_formula,
    " + Capacity_MW + Start_year + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
    " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh + rGDP_pc + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )

  cox_model_psm <- coxph(
    as.formula(formula_str),
    data = matched_data,
    cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
    ties = "efron",
    control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
  )

  coef_summary <- summary(cox_model_psm)$coefficients
  has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)

  for (i in 1:4) {
    type <- types[i]
    var_name <- proximity_vars[i]

    if (has_robust) {
      coef_val <- coef_summary[i, "coef"]
      se <- coef_summary[i, "robust se"]
      pval <- coef_summary[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    } else {
      coef_val <- coef_summary[i, "coef"]
      se <- coef_summary[i, "se(coef)"]
      pval <- coef_summary[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    }

    hr <- exp(coef_val)
    ci_lower <- exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se)
    ci_upper <- exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se)

    result_row <- data.frame(
      Distance = dist,
      Type = type,
      Variable = var_name,
      Coefficient = coef_val,
      HR = hr,
      SE = se,
      CI_lower = ci_lower,
      CI_upper = ci_upper,
      P_value = pval,
      Sig = case_when(
        pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
        pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
        pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )

    results_psm_list[[length(results_psm_list) + 1]] <- result_row
  }
}

results_psm_df <- bind_rows(results_psm_list)

# ============================================================
# 6. Compare results before and after PSM
# ============================================================

results_original <- readRDS(file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_results_joint.rds")) %>%
  filter(Distance == "25km")

comparison_df <- results_original %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Type, Variable,
    HR_original = HR,
    CI_lower_original = CI_lower,
    CI_upper_original = CI_upper,
    P_original = P_value,
    Sig_original = Sig
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    results_psm_df %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Type, Variable,
        HR_psm = HR,
        CI_lower_psm = CI_lower,
        CI_upper_psm = CI_upper,
        P_psm = P_value,
        Sig_psm = Sig
      ),
    by = c("Type", "Variable")
  )

print(
  comparison_df %>%
    dplyr::select(Type, HR_original, HR_psm, Sig_original, Sig_psm)
)

# ============================================================
# 7. PANEL B: FOREST PLOT
# ============================================================

nature_colors <- c(
  "before06" = "#000080",
  "06_15" = "#4169E1",
  "16_19" = "#9E1C60",
  "20_24" = "#FF4500"
)

plot_comparison_data <- comparison_df %>%
  mutate(
    Type_clean = case_when(
      Type == "before06" ~ "Before 2006",
      Type == "06_15" ~ "2006-2015",
      Type == "16_19" ~ "2016-2019",
      Type == "20_24" ~ "2020-2024"
    ),
    plot_order = case_when(
      Type_clean == "Before 2006" ~ 4,
      Type_clean == "2006-2015" ~ 3,
      Type_clean == "2016-2019" ~ 2,
      Type_clean == "2020-2024" ~ 1
    )
  )

x_min <- min(
  c(plot_comparison_data$CI_lower_original, plot_comparison_data$CI_lower_psm),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
x_max <- max(
  c(plot_comparison_data$CI_upper_original, plot_comparison_data$CI_upper_psm),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
x_range <- x_max - x_min
x_limit_min <- x_min - 0.15 * x_range
x_limit_max <- x_max + 0.30 * x_range

plot_comparison_data <- plot_comparison_data %>%
  mutate(
    label_x_original = pmin(CI_upper_original + 0.03 * x_range, x_limit_max - 0.10 * x_range),
    label_x_psm = pmin(CI_upper_psm + 0.03 * x_range, x_limit_max - 0.10 * x_range),
    hr_label_original = sprintf("%.3f%s", HR_original, Sig_original),
    hr_label_psm = sprintf("%.3f%s", HR_psm, Sig_psm)
  )

forest_plot_psm <- ggplot(plot_comparison_data, aes(y = plot_order)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "solid",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS
  ) +

  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = CI_lower_original, xmax = CI_upper_original, color = Type),
    height = 0,
    linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_ERROR,
    alpha = 0.6,
    linetype = "solid",
    position = position_nudge(y = 0.15)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = HR_original, color = Type, fill = Type),
    shape = 21,
    size = POINT_SIZE,
    stroke = POINT_STROKE,
    position = position_nudge(y = 0.15)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x_original, label = hr_label_original, color = Type),
    hjust = 0,
    size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT * 0.35,
    fontface = "bold",
    position = position_nudge(y = 0.15),
    family = FONT_FAMILY
  ) +

  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = CI_lower_psm, xmax = CI_upper_psm, color = Type),
    height = 0,
    linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_ERROR,
    linetype = "dashed",
    position = position_nudge(y = -0.15)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = HR_psm, color = Type),
    shape = 17,
    size = POINT_SIZE,
    stroke = POINT_STROKE,
    position = position_nudge(y = -0.15)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x_psm, label = hr_label_psm, color = Type),
    hjust = 0,
    size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT * 0.35,
    fontface = "bold",
    position = position_nudge(y = -0.15),
    family = FONT_FAMILY
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = nature_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "before06" = "white",
    "06_15" = "white",
    "16_19" = "white",
    "20_24" = "white"
  )) +

  labs(
    x = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = "Data center commission periods"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = FONT_SIZE_BASE, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY, color = "black"),

    plot.title = element_text(
      size = FONT_SIZE_TITLE,
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(b = 8)
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT,
      color = "black",
      margin = margin(t = 4)
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT,
      color = "black",
      hjust = 1.1,
      vjust = 1.1,
      angle = -30,
      margin = margin(r = 4)
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE,
      margin = margin(t = 8)
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE,
      angle = 90,
      margin = margin(r = 8)
    ),

    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),

    legend.position = "none",

    plot.margin = PLOT_MARGIN,
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_limit_min, x_limit_max),
    breaks = pretty(c(x_min, x_max), n = 6),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:4,
    labels = c("2020-2024", "2016-2019", "2006-2015", "Before 2006"),
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.5))
  )

plot_psm_grob <- ggplotGrob(forest_plot_psm)
plot_psm_grob$widths[2] <- FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH
plot_psm_grob$widths[3] <- FIXED_YAXIS_WIDTH

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(path_figures, "si_fig6b.pdf"),
  plot = plot_psm_grob,
  width = 6,
  height = 3.5,
  units = "in",
  device = "pdf"
)

print(forest_plot_psm)
```
